about: The soft-tissue plugin's records: published fibrin values (open, in the package), a placeholder gel, and a placeholder for a lab's private data (its own licence, referenced, never shipped).

assets.name: softtissue_fibrin_plasma
assets.credit: values from Tutwiler et al. 2020 (Sci. Adv. 6:eabc0496) and 2021 (Acta Biomater. 131:355); record by the plugin's authors

assets.name: softtissue_gel_placeholder
assets.credit: placeholder values by the plugin's authors

assets.name: softtissue.whole_blood_clot
assets.credit: calibrated by the plugin's pure-shear study from data digitised from Lohr et al. 2025 (Int. J. Fract., doi:10.1007/s10704-024-00820-4); record by the plugin's authors

assets.name: softtissue.puncture_gel
assets.credit: values from Fakhouri, Hutchens and Crosby 2015 (Soft Matter 11, 4723) as stated by Fregonese and Bacca 2021 (J. Mech. Phys. Solids, doi:10.1016/j.jmps.2021.104497); record by the plugin's authors
